scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix functions run build && concurrently -k -n fn,emu,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm --prefix functions run build:watch" "firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-amatomo" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-amatomo
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test:ci: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-amatomo "node scripts/smoke-test.mjs"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --project amatomodemo --force
